text:
The plate is about 20-26 cm across and spans roughly 360 px in the image. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is about 0.07 cm per px.

The two bacon strips are each about 250 px long, which is roughly 17 cm at that scale. That is a bit long, so the plate may be nearer 22 cm, which would make each strip about 14-15 cm. Cooked bacon strips weigh about 8 g each for standard cut, or about 12 g for thick cut. These look fairly thick and well cooked, so I'd estimate about 10 g each, or 20 g in total.

Cooked bacon runs about 540 kcal per 100 g, so 20 g comes to roughly 108 kcal. Allowing for some visible grease, I'll round up to about 110 kcal.
